ModMetaData.name: Coinage - Gold Currency & MO Smelting 1.5 V3
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 patch. Coin_Gold is the settlement currency while vanilla Silver remains the pricing unit. All runtime-generated Coinage coins are universally tradeable as goods. MO Furnace gets 10/100/1000/2000 pure-metal coin remelting recipes with dynamic runtime ingredient injection and source-metal output.
